name: Find OOX-17/TN!
summary: In Tanaris, you turn the knob and Find OOX-17/TN! springs to life. Oglethorpe's voice says his homing robot is missing and asks you to carry the beacon to it.

sections.title: A Voice From the Egg
sections.body: A knob opens the strange egg, revealing a gnomish contraption. A voice crackles from within and names its speaker as Oglethorpe. His homing robot has gone missing. Oglethorpe has computed where it went down, near the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris, and asks you to take the beacon there.

sections.title: At the Crash Site
sections.body: The missing homing robot at the crash site is a robotic chicken. Oglethorpe says it needs a jump start before it can fly home to Booty Bay for repairs, so you put the beacon inside. Hums and whirs follow as the chicken struggles to stand. Then Oglethorpe's voice comes from the robot itself. It works, but needs major repairs and is too heavy for you to lift.

faq.q: Who is contacting you through the device?
faq.answer: A voice from inside the egg names its speaker as Oglethorpe. He says his homing robot has gone missing.

faq.q: Where did the homing robot crash?
aliases: where do i bring the beacon
faq.answer: Oglethorpe's computed coordinates place the crash near the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris.
Oglethorpe asks you to bring the beacon to his missing homing robot.
